queries:
WITH rc AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall_avg FROM rc
)
SELECT AVG(rc.cnt) AS avg_above, AVG(rc.cnt - o.overall_avg) AS avg_diff
FROM rc, o
WHERE rc.cnt > o.overall_avg;
WITH rc AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM rc
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS mean_rental_count_above_avg,
       AVG(cnt) - (SELECT a FROM o) AS diff_from_overall_avg
FROM rc
WHERE cnt > (SELECT a FROM o);
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental re
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cnt FROM r
)
SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings,
       AVG(r.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_difference_above_overall
FROM r, o
WHERE r.cnt > o.avg_cnt;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT re.inventory_id) AS cnt
  FROM rental re
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall_avg FROM r
)
SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_above_rating_count,
       AVG(r.cnt - o.overall_avg) AS avg_difference_above_overall
FROM r, o
WHERE r.cnt > o.overall_avg;
